_comment: Fleet registry of the maind node: the state that maind itself writes (projects, namespaces, agent definitions, MCP servers, provider selection, role packs). Copy to <state>/maind/registry.json (maind projects/onboard create it on first write). Settings of the node (node, memory, graph, code_graph, agents timings, integrations, mcp policy, observability) are not here: they live in the [maind] table of config.toml, see config.example.toml. Superset of .projects.json from brain: projects[].{id,name,repo,local_path,type} are compatible with brain, the rest are maind extensions.
_comment_agents: agents.definitions: descriptors of the agents that live on this node. Timings of the registry are settings ([maind.agents]).
_comment_mcp: mcp.servers: extra MCP servers rolled out into projects next to the hub ones. The policy (emit_example, perplexity_web) is a setting ([maind.mcp]).
_comment_namespaces: Optional registry namespace-groups (id → {name, description}). Cross-project link isolation: edge A↔B in the graph is built only if A and B share at least one namespace (field projects[].namespaces). The registry is needed only for metadata and typo hints - membership is set in projects. No registry → namespace are free.
_comment_projects: Ecosystem projects. Minimum for compatibility with brain: id, name, repo, local_path, type. The remaining fields are extensions maind. namespaces: list of project groups - connections are isolated by group; no/empty → implicit 'default' (everything is connected as before); ['*'] → common infrastructure, communicates with EVERYONE namespace. Add. federation options: graph_store=local (project graph in <local_path>/.maind/graph.db, and not on the hub); vault_path — for derive doc-connections from Brain frontmatter; inter-project relationships not inferred from code/docks, declare them in the project's .swissknifeman/config.toml: [maind.graph.links.getchat] type = "relates_to", plane = "runtime", note = "REST". docs_folders: doc-folders {id,vault,repo,visibility} — cache from frontmatter Brain (source of truth visibility — there, not here; names of the parties vault/repo may vary). repo = GitHub-slug owner/name; path to code - local_path (in brain-schema .projects.json repo = path, when importing → local_path).
